name: University of Lausanne
feeMethod: Charges the same CHF 580 per semester for every programme, so every major costs the same.
description: The University of Lausanne (UNIL) is a public university in Lausanne, founded as an academy in 1537 and a university since 1890. It has seven faculties, including HEC Lausanne, law, biology and medicine, and teaches mainly in French.
whyIncluded: The University of Lausanne is an NUS Student Exchange Programme partner, so NUS undergraduates can spend a semester studying in Lausanne.

livingCosts.summary: The university's own basic student budget per month, using the middle of its ranges. Day-to-day costs such as transport are inside its living and food figure. Excludes health insurance and fees.
livingCosts.notes: UNIL 'FAQ et liens utiles' page, section 'Cout de la vie en Suisse pour un etudiant' (the old 'Taxes d'etudes et cout de la vie' page now redirects; same figures, re-read 2026-10-14): basic student budget about CHF 2,050 a month = living and food CHF 850-900, accommodation CHF 700-900, health and accident insurance CHF 150-300, books and course material CHF 100-150. Midpoints used: housing 800; food 875 (UNIL's combined 'living and food' line, which also covers everyday costs such as local transport, so transport is 0 rather than double counted); personal 125 (books and course material). Insurance excluded. Months = 12 because the budget is monthly with no academic-year length. Page undated, read 2026-10-07.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Management (HEC Lausanne)
programmes.feeBasis: Lausanne's flat CHF 580 per semester x 2 for every bachelor's and master's, no foreign surcharge; CHF 200 application processing fee once.
programmes.feeChoice: Every bachelor's and master's charges the same rate, with no foreign surcharge, so one rate covers the whole degree.
programmes.summary: Yearly course and semester fees, the same for Swiss and international students. A one-off CHF 200 application processing fee applies to applicants with foreign qualifications.
programmes.notes: UNIL immatriculation page 'Taxes d'etudes et cout de la vie': 'Bachelor, Master, EFLE: CHF 580.- per semester' (course enrolment + semester fees combined), no surcharge for foreign students, so CHF 580 x 2 = 1,160. No separate compulsory contributions listed. One-off: CHF 200 administrative fee for processing applications from bachelor applicants with a foreign secondary certificate and master applicants without a Swiss university degree (https://unil.ch/immat/en/home/menuinst/futurs-etudiants/sinscrire.html). Page undated, read 2026-10-07; feeYear 2026 is the current rate. No 2024/2025 rows: no dated UNIL or Vaud source for those years was found this session (the fee has long been CHF 580 but that is not documented here). 3-year (180 ECTS) HEC Lausanne bachelor, taught mainly in French. On 2026-10-13 the UNIL 'Guide general 2024-2025' PDF and Directive 3.2 (taxes et delais) on unil.ch/files were found but cannot be read (robots-disallowed to the fetch tool), and the undated 'Tuition and semester fees' page names no academic year, so 2024/2025 rows are still missing. Round 2 (2026-10-13): r.jina.ai renderings of UNIL pages failed, and the Vaud regulation RTI-UL (in force since 1 July 2011) sets only the CHF 500 semester course fee, not a dated 2024/25 or 2025/26 total, so no rows were added. Round 4 (2026-10-13): swissuniversities' tuition-fee table (500 + 80 other fees per semester) is labelled only 'Academic year 2026-27', and iamexpat.ch and mimineurope.com tie CHF 580 only to 2026, so no 2024/2025 rows. Round 5 (2026-10-13): curl now reads unil.ch/files. UNIL's general guide '2025-2026 Tous les cursus d'etudes a l'UNIL' (guide-general-2025_web.pdf, linked from unil.ch/unil/fr/home/profils/futures-etudiantes-etudiants.html) states 'Taxe d'inscription aux cours : 580 CHF par semestre', so 2025 row = 1,160 (official). 2024: Directive 3.2 'sur les taxes et delais' (dir3-2-taxes-delais.pdf, PDF of 20 Jan 2026) sets CHF 500 course fee (art. 3) + CHF 80 semester fees (art. 4) per semester; its 'Tableau des modifications' shows the 12.12.2023 restructuring (art. 4 change only to the allocation of the semester fee) and, after that, only the 02.12.2025 update of article 15 (deadlines), so the CHF 580/semester rate was in force throughout 2024-25: 2024 row = 1,160 (official, from the directive's amendment history; no 2024-2025 guide PDF found: guide-general-2024*_web.pdf variants return 404).
